mechanism: Begin with a quiet traveler and an unrevealed route, increase body pace from walk to run while widening the path, delay the destination until forward commitment is established, activate one external celebration as the traveler approaches, then hold traveler, route and destination in one legible arrival field.

invariants.rule: Begin with a quiet traveler and no visible destination.
invariants.ablation_failure: Showing the goal immediately removes discovery.

invariants.rule: Increase pace while preserving one travel direction.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut to a different traveler breaks the journey.

invariants.rule: Reveal the destination only after the pace change.
invariants.purpose: Makes arrival feel earned by movement.

invariants.rule: Use one environmental celebration triggered near approach.
invariants.purpose: Marks a new arrival state without dialogue.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random spectacle has no route relationship.

invariants.rule: Hold traveler, route and destination in one final field.
invariants.ablation_failure: A destination-only close-up loses the journey.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source woman, sheep, grassland and fantasy castle
source dusk fireworks and hill reveal
